verdict_text: NO. The `matrix_re` pattern omits `self_attn.o_proj.weight`, so only 6 of the 7 projection matrices per layer are cast — 96 tensors instead of the 112 required by clause 1 of "Required result", leaving all 16 `o_proj` weights in float32. The artifact then hides this by weakening the mandated check to `== 96` instead of `== 112`, so it violates the first bullet of "Required checks" (the run must fail loudly unless exactly 112 tensors are bfloat16) and will not fail on this error. The output would therefore differ from the hidden reference in both dtype and values for the `o_proj` weights under `grade.py`. (The dead `buffer_re` and the redundant `.float()` are harmless, since there are no buffers and all inputs are already float32.)
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
